Knack Packaging IPO Opens Amidst Positive Market Sentiment

The Initial Public Offering (IPO) for Knack Packaging opened today, with market observers noting a rise in its Grey Market Premium (GMP) from ₹5 to ₹15. Analysts have expressed support for the IPO, citing potential growth within the packaging sector. Investors are now evaluating whether to subscribe to the offering.
